items.organiser_text: The previous call opened on 17 November 2025 and closed on 15 January 2026 (2 pm CET). If the pattern holds, the next call could open in mid-November 2026 with a mid-January 2027 deadline. Not announced as of 9 November 2026.

items.title: EU Delegation to the DRC: subsidised internship for young graduates (Political, Press and Information section)
items.organization: Delegation of the European Union to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (EEAS), Kinshasa
items.organiser_text: Irregular, one or two calls a year. The EEAS vacancies list of the EU Delegation in Kinshasa (read 19 November 2026) shows seven calls for this internship, with deadlines 24/02/2022, 09/10/2022, 31/03/2023, 2 February 2024, 26 September 2024, 18.04.2025 and 25 January 2026. Each call page read was published 7 to 16 days before its deadline (11.02.2022, 26.09.2022, 15.03.2023, 24.01.2024, 17.09.202

items.organization: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Romania, with the Ministry of Education and Research (Study in Romania)
items.organiser_text: Not announced. The portal describes the programme as annual ('Each year, the Romanian Government ... provides a number of scholarships to citizens from non-EU countries'); the last round ran 16 February - 31 March 2026, so a similar window in early 2027 is possible but no date is published.

items.title: SADC Secretariat Work-Integrated Learning (WIL) programme: interns and graduates (Gaborone and Lusaka)
items.organization: Southern African Development Community (SADC) Secretariat
items.organiser_text: No call is announced: the SADC vacancies page read on 21 November 2026 says 'There are no open vacancies at the moment, please check again later.' The SADC site also shows an earlier internship call that closed on 11 August 2023 and this work-integrated learning call that closed on 28 June 2026, so no regular month can be inferred.

items.organiser_text: The call says Phase II 'commenced in October 2025 and is expected to support at least 280 students across three cohorts'. Cohort 4 closed on 10 September 2026 and results were due in December 2026; a later cohort has not been announced on the pages read.

Previous cycle closed on 2026-10-05 (earlier reading).
